column1: # Expected clock counts for the sprdma_and_dmc_dma ROMs, and what Emu198x
# currently measures. Obtained from Mesen2 (which passes both ROMs) via
# tools/mesen-nes-cross-check; Emu198x column from the sprdma_dmc_probe test.
# The ROM sweeps 16 get/put alignments (T+) and prints the total clocks each
# takes. Emu198x fails both with #01 because its CRC over these 16 values
# differs. Recorded so the defect can be targeted by diff rather than guessed
# at: every difference is +1, never -1 and never more than 1, at exactly the
# alignments where the reference takes the SHORTER path. Emu198x is one cycle
# too slow at half the alignments -- an alignment cycle taken unconditionally
# where hardware takes it only when the get/put phase demands it.
# ⚠ Not a gate. Nothing asserts against this file; it is the oracle the fix is
# aimed at. The gate is sweep-baseline-v1.tsv, which records the FAILING
# Verified not to be the cause (each measured, each disproved):
#   * OAM DMA alone -- 513/514 by alignment, correct
#   * DMC DMA alone -- 3/4 by alignment, correct
#   * combined stall with a sliding $4014 -- alternates 515/516, correct
#   * inverting the get/put phase to match Mesen's pre-increment evaluation --
#     the ROM then never settles at all
#   * the OAM transfer itself -- a cycle-by-cycle bus-op diff against Mesen2
#     matches on all 16 transfers, address for address, so the extra cycle is
#     NOT inside the transfer. See the campaign record.
